# BACTEREMIA ASSOCIATED WITH OTHER GRAM-NEGATIVE RODS

[Pseudomonas bacteremia](orzid2-gmenu-bacteremia-pseudomonas)

Other Gram-negative rods typically associated with bacteremia include

Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Proteus spp. and other species.

Identification and treatment of the source of infection, in addition to

antimicrobial therapy, is crucial for resolution of infection. This may include

removal of catheters and draining of abscesses if present.

# Consult ID for Acinetobacter, Bacteroides and Stenotrophomonas

# Duration of therapy

Treat for a total of 7 days with source control.  Most patients can rapidly

transition to an oral antibiotic. Call Infectious Diseases or Stewardship Team

for more information.

# Treatment for non-ESBL producing organisms (e.g. CTX-M negative)

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h \($\) M](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)

# Treatment for ESBL producing organisms (e.g. CTX-M positive)

[Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h \($$\) R,O](psjizid-meropenem-1gm-iv-q8h)
